Settings.EnableDockHint: Displays an independent draggable window with portraits of connected players and the GM's active NPC.
Settings.EnableMicHint: Requests microphone access to locally measure voice volume (audio is never recorded or streamed).
Settings.MicBoostHint: Multiplier for quieter headsets or microphones with active noise gates (default x2.5).
Settings.MicThresholdHint: Minimum volume level required to trigger the speaking glow (default 8%).
Settings.ReleaseDelayHint: How long the glow remains active after you stop speaking to prevent flickering between words (default 350ms).
Settings.PlayerGlowColorHint: Neon halo color when players speak (default #43b581 - Discord green).
Settings.GmGlowColorHint: Neon halo color when the GM speaks (default #f1c40f - golden).
Settings.EnableDioramaHint: When Fried Diorama is enabled, highlights full-body character portraits on the diorama stage.
Settings.GlowIntensityHint: Adjusts the brightness and width of the neon aura around the character in Fried Diorama.
Settings.ShowDioramaNameHint: Displays a clean name badge over the talking character during dialogue.
